caseName: Missouri ex rel. City of Sedalia v. Public Service Commission
caseNameFull: State of Missouri at the Relation of City of Sedalia v. Public Service Commission of Missouri, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Missouri.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Pawhuska v. Pawhuska Oil Co., 250 U. S. 394. See Chicago v. Dempcy, 250 U. S. 651. Mr. Eugene C. Brockmeyer for plaintiff in error. Mr. James D. Lindsay for defendants in error.
